supersedes.reason: Version 6 completed one live ReDCO optimizer step with a nonconstant four-branch counterfactual group, but its frozen config did not enable Prime's file monitor. The verifier correctly refused to substitute console text for machine-readable trainer metrics. Prime also correctly filtered zero-advantage records from the effective subset, so requiring all ten collected traces to remain effective was not a valid integration contract.

scope.purpose: Prove that the 4B LoRA Stage C path completes one exact-snapshot ReDCO update, records auditable trainer metrics, and retains a compact adapter without gathering redundant full-model weights.

behavior_action_policy.representation: one model token from the complete behavior-policy support

decoder.temperature_constraint: greater than zero and less than or equal to the pinned vLLM maximum of 2.0

behavior_action_policy.invalid_action_semantics: Any token whose exact decoded text is not an allowed action digit is executed without repair or resampling and receives the probe's deterministic failure reward.
behavior_action_policy.same_distribution_contract: Original and three alternatives use the same checkpoint, prompt, temperature, top-p, tool state, maximum length, and unrestricted token support; only structural seed and cache salt vary.
behavior_action_policy.trainer_contract: Prime resolves each sample temperature from the trace's recorded agent sampling configuration, falling back to the environment temperature only when no trace agent exists.

evidence_and_storage_contract.effective_subset_semantics: Prime may omit zero-advantage contexts or complete zero-signal groups; every retained branch group must remain complete and have nonconstant rewards.
evidence_and_storage_contract.reason: The filesystem broadcast adapter is sufficient for the experimental checkpoint. Gathering the unchanged 4B base model produced about 8.0 GB of redundant local data in version 6.

hardware.spot_policy: reject the resource if provisioning identifies it as spot or preemptible
prohibited: a second simultaneous Stage C pod

resource_policy.stop_if_v2_lifecycle_error_recurs: ValueError: clean Stage C permits one collected group per snapshot

mandatory: all frozen source hashes match locally and remotely
exactly two complete collected episodes and ten collected traces are serialized under policy version zero
the effective subset contains at least one complete four-branch group with nonconstant branch rewards
each effective branch records exactly one sampled token, temperature 2.0, a distinct structural seed, and a distinct cache salt
invalid displayed actions, if any, are retained with null canonical action and their true deterministic failure reward
every target is committed before action sampling
all effective branch records report exact sliced/full reward equivalence
the trainer metrics file contains exactly one finite positive optimizer gradient norm
a non-empty filesystem-broadcast LoRA adapter is saved
no gathered full-model safetensors checkpoint is produced
decision_rule.failure: sync all artifacts, emit a signed structured failure, terminate compute, and do not start a learning arm
